# Loop Observatory

A Muse agent skill that inspects LoopKit run telemetry: summarize a run, compare runs to find regressions, rank loop templates by reliability, and detect failure hotspots (retries, verifier churn, flapping loops). Strictly read-only — it never writes, executes, or modifies anything, so it's safe to run even on runs you haven't written. No account, no API key, no network needed.
